title: Filter by brand
text: Find gear faster: filter the catalog by brand or category, with item counts. Active filters show as removable chips.

title: Easier onboarding
text: Create your first Rig and find your Presets more easily.

title: Choose your avatar
text: Pick an avatar from your profile: it shows up in the top bar.

title: Catalog filter
text: Sort the Gear catalog by newest or trending.

title: Light theme
text: Choose Dark, Light or Auto from the new Settings menu.

title: Rig autosave
text: Your Rig is now saved automatically as you build it.
